contentSummary: This is the credentials/certifications page and it is almost entirely images with no explanatory copy. The body is one two-column Bootstrap layout: an 8-column main area holding an H1 "Our Credentials" followed by a 3-row × 2-column grid of six scanned certificate JPGs (no captions, no alt text, no titles, no issuer names, no validity dates, not clickable/zoomable), and a 4-column sidebar with two widgets — "Our Companies" (links to SSPSB and JJSB) and "Contact Us" (Bhavnagar address, phone, email as plain text). Below that sits a full-width band whose only content is the line "ISO 30000:2009, ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015 & 45001:2018 Certified Companies", and then a bare copyright bar. For an…
